notes: Auto DJ transitions rebuilt and measured on an offline bench: transition length from the tracks' own outro and intro, bass hand-over without a dip, vocal ducking, beat-phase servo and late-start compensation, steady loudness and a true limiter ceiling (the browser's limiter was adding 0.85 dB). Crossfades of 6 s and longer are shaped and beat-matched. Left rail shows screen names. Endless set from a crate or a list.
